latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Voiceover for Video — Add AI Narration to Videos.

- Add AI-generated voiceover narration to uploaded video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB).
- Fast cloud GPU processing returns 1080p MP4 output in 30–60 seconds.
- Simple onboarding with automatic token setup and user feedback.
- Supports user actions like upload, export, credits check, and timeline preview.
- Clear feedback and error handling for file size, unsupported formats, and credit status.
